structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a copycat of the "American Reserved Oil Supply" (AROS) meme coin, which is currently popular on Solana. It was deployed straight onto a PumpSwap pool, without the pump.fun "pump" address suffix, about 19 minutes before detection. The creator has closed out, 100% of the LP is unlocked, and there are no socials or website. The packet lists at least 9 other AROS tokens. The main ones sit at $360M–$900M market cap (packet figures). Two recent copies with the same non-pump deploy pattern were made within about 2 hours of this one, and both now show $0 liquidity. One of them (DcMYcV...) still shows $245k of 1h volume, which is the same pump-then-pull pattern this coin shows now. The buy flow here is lopsided: 1,620 unique buyers against 99 sellers and $315k of volume on a $27k market cap. That looks like buyers mistaking this for the real AROS, or bot flow, while the deployer can pull the LP at any time.

narrative.description: AROS / American Reserved Oil Supply, a meme coin themed on the US strategic oil reserve. The canonical tokens are already at hundreds of millions in market cap, according to the packet and aggregator pages.
narrative.why_spreading: A large, active parent narrative draws buyers who search for the ticker and land on copies. The attention belongs to the parent token, not this contract.

token_connection.why_this_token: None. It is a same-name clone launched hours after the main AROS tokens, with no socials and no profile.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 57LVTC...pump ($901M), QcakAH...pump ($860M, same full name), 2DznHs...pump ($711M) and others. Recent non-pump clones DcMYcV... and Jt8i14... already show $0 liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: Clone deployed directly to PumpSwap with 100% of the LP unlocked and a single LP provider. The creator has closed out. Sibling clones of the same pattern were rugged within the last 2 hours. Buyers outnumber sellers about 16:1. Nothing about this contract turned up in web search.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not check X directly. The buyers may be real people who were misled rather than bots, but either way the deployer controls the exit.

structural_risks: 100% of the LP is unlocked and controlled by the deployer (RugCheck danger rating)
Sibling clones of the same pattern already sit at $0 liquidity
Ticker hijack of a much larger canonical token
8 bundler wallets flagged; the creator closed out

structured_output.counterargument: Liquidity ($42k) is higher than the market cap, and buying is heavy and broad: 1,620 unique buyers with a +40% move over the last 5 minutes. The top 10 holders own only about 11%. If the deployer lets it run instead of pulling, clone confusion alone could briefly push it to 2x from a $27k base.
